principle: Only meaningful, public-safe engineering work is published. Raw commits, private conversations, credentials, proprietary logic and unverified claims stay out of the public feed.

active.title: Observable Temporal State Field production readiness
active.summary: The locked homepage visual authority is being taken through final release verification: public system state drives the temporal field, rejected research remains visible, reduced-motion is static, and the existing evidence, career and system interactions remain intact.
active.evidence: The current candidate passes static export, browser-error, WCAG A/AA, desktop/mobile interaction, state-binding, reduced-motion and visual-capture gates. Final artifact review is being used to reconcile public state before production promotion.
active.next_gate: Complete the final state-consistency run and visual review, then promote the exact validated candidate in one production deployment.

entries.title: Observable Temporal State Field became the visual authority
entries.summary: The homepage moved from a light decorative field to a dark observable-system environment where visual structure is tied to public maturity, evidence and research state rather than arbitrary decoration.
entries.evidence: The implementation includes state-bound TradeBot, Control Core, Automation and Analytics bands, past/present/next framing, rejected-research traces, an explicit field explainer and responsive reduced-motion behavior.
entries.next_gate: Keep future visual changes subordinate to system truth, accessibility and public evidence boundaries.

entries.title: Discoverability, public proof and recruiter handoff hardening
entries.summary: Post-launch review tightened how Aixion Lab is discovered, shared and trusted: production-facing placeholders were removed, evidence summaries became more explicit and public identity was strengthened without adding unverified claims.
entries.evidence: The review used production-tested desktop/mobile artifacts and existing accessibility, interaction and visual regression gates rather than repeated hosting previews.
entries.next_gate: Continue publishing only evidence-backed recruiter and public-proof improvements.

entries.title: Editorial closing principle became a wide two-line signature
entries.summary: The closing statement was rebuilt from an oversized centered text block into two intentional, edge-spanning editorial lines with a quieter supporting sign-off.
entries.evidence: The production browser suite measures the footer width, line wrapping and horizontal coverage on desktop; the final typography candidate passed the complete build and browser suite.
entries.next_gate: Preserve the closing principle as the authored endpoint of the site.

entries.title: Live UAT removed interaction and layout distractions
entries.summary: Production review simplified the search surface, removed redundant footer navigation and corrected the Control Core first-load reveal so its center no longer shifts during animation.
entries.evidence: Focused browser regressions passed for first-load Control Core centering, the quieter Search control and the authored closing footer.
entries.next_gate: Verify the same behavior on the production custom domain after deployment.

entries.title: Public worklog and activity publishing
entries.summary: Ongoing Aixion engineering work now feeds a curated public activity layer that surfaces current work, evidence and next gates without exposing raw repository or conversation data.
entries.evidence: Home and Pulse read from a structured public-safe activity manifest, with dedicated worklog acceptance tests in the production suite.
entries.next_gate: Use the manifest for future meaningful milestones and keep publication evidence-led.

entries.title: Production candidate passed release gates
entries.summary: The launch candidate passed static-export, browser, accessibility, internal-link, reduced-motion and production-content checks before promotion.
entries.evidence: The release suite passed its browser and production gates on the validated candidate.
entries.next_gate: Preserve the same release discipline for subsequent visual and evidence changes.

entries.title: Aixion Signal became the interaction language
entries.summary: The site now uses state-driven motion, architecture-specific reveal patterns and reduced-motion fallbacks instead of generic decorative animation.
entries.evidence: Interaction acceptance tests and desktop/mobile renders passed in the production suite.
entries.next_gate: Keep future motion changes subordinate to usability and state communication.

entries.title: Initial light-mineral website authority
entries.summary: The clean rebuild was initially anchored to a light-mineral visual system and the current public architecture. The architecture and evidence rules remain authoritative, while the visual layer was later superseded by the Observable Temporal State Field.
entries.evidence: The original master blueprint established the page architecture, state vocabulary, evidence boundaries and accessibility expectations that remain preserved.
entries.next_gate: Retain the architecture and governance rules while treating the observable field as the current visual authority.

entries.title: Research and live evidence kept separate from proprietary strategy detail
entries.summary: The public TradeBot story exposes architecture, validation method and evidence boundaries without publishing private signal mechanics or execution rules.
entries.evidence: Public pages distinguish research evidence, live observation, risk and human authority instead of collapsing them into one claim.
entries.next_gate: Add sanitized operational proof only when it is safe and evidence-backed.

entries.title: MVP orchestration translated into inspectable stages
entries.summary: Intent, context, planning, agents, tools, evidence, policy and authority were separated into explicit stages for the public architecture.
entries.evidence: The site presents a labelled demo trace while explicitly avoiding fake production telemetry.
entries.next_gate: Promote a policy-bound execution trace backed by implementation evidence.
